summary: P1 meets its outcome: validate errors carry their source line (schema and relation-triple errors alike), type errors on scalars read in the card's form, and arch-validate prints the line while leaving line-less errors byte-identical; well pinned by tests. Two advisory message-quality edges only.

findings.summary: Type error on an empty value renders an empty source scalar ('a:  (parsed as null) …'), less clear than the old 'value null …'
JSON body with duplicate keys: line/source come from the first occurrence while the validated value is the last
